title: SM-16.10 - How external users can export survey data during the transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.10 - How external users can export survey data during the transition
short_answer: External users should export their survey data before April 2027. The exported files can be used for reporting, analysis, or archiving.
procedure: Go to the Results tab in the tabular view.
Enter a name for the export file.
Select a format, for example XLSX.
Download the file from the Exports tab once it is ready.
